Description: A fragmentary Hebrew copy of Isaiah from Qumran Cave 4, published in DJD XV (Skehan-Ulrich) as 4Q63. It preserves only the opening six verses of Isaiah, the superscription and the opening accusation against Judah.
Significance: One of several Qumran copies preserving Isaiah's opening chapter, showing that the book's first verses were copied independently in multiple Cave 4 scrolls; it proves nothing beyond Isaiah 1:1-6.
